highlights: 自行维护的二次开发版本，保留 czg86389-hub/muse2api 原作者致谢与 MIT 许可证。
新增管理页批量网页登录：邮箱/手机号加自动取码链接或手动验证码；隔离账号会话，完成上游认证后保存 Cookie，不是账号密码直登，也不绕过人工验证。
账号重复会话自动归并；已认证邮箱或稳定用户身份支持跨会话去重，代理/身份冲突拒绝合并，旧账号 ID 保留别名并备份迁移数据。
维护设置可配置保活和额度查询周期，关闭管理页后后台仍会运行；复用原 Settings 页面查询真实额度与重置文案，不虚构有效期和最后业务使用时间。
账号额度改为卡片展示：套餐、已用百分比与进度条、额度重置时间、Cookie 有效期及最近刷新；未知值明确显示未知。
新增持久脱敏诊断日志：按任务/账号筛选上传、发送、等待成品、取回与重试阶段，保留错误类型和安全异常栈；写入故障不影响已成功的视频。
更新后请强制刷新管理页。扩展仍为 1.0.2、油猴脚本 1.1.2，无需重装；旧扩展仍需手动在每个浏览器个人资料中升级。
highlights_en: Self-maintained fork of czg86389-hub/muse2api; original authorship and MIT license preserved.
Admin-managed batch login uses email/phone plus automatic mailbox-code URL or manual OTP, isolated browser contexts and verified upstream sessions, not password login or CAPTCHA bypass.
Deduplicate identical sessions and verified account identities with conflict checks, legacy ID aliases and private migration backups; unknown identities are not guessed.
Configurable background session and quota maintenance reuses the existing Settings-page automation. Real expiry and last business use remain distinct from maintenance timestamps.
Quota account cards show the plan, validated usage percentage/progress, upstream reset information, cookie expiry and last refresh. Unknown data stays unknown.
Persistent redacted task diagnostics cover upload, send, wait, extraction and retry phases, error types and safe stack frames without exposing credentials.
Hard-refresh the dashboard after updating. Extension remains 1.0.2 and userscript 1.1.2; older extensions still require a manual upgrade in every browser profile.
